blocking_findings: The work advantage is shared by quadratic, spline and ReLU continuations and is not identified as neural.
The representation comparison is not matched by effective rank, approximation budget, training work or serialized complexity.
The 1/16 equivalence margin lacks external economic calibration and is large relative to the observed effects.
The execution is confined to a two-date, two-state, scalar-control problem.
Timing evidence comes from one completed execution and does not identify a reusable acquisition frontier.
The local freeze was not remotely timestamped before primary evaluation, and the strongest certificate re-accounting is post-evaluation.
Independent checking does not reproduce the full learning, policy-evaluation and inference stack.
The release workflow and tests gate fail.
The cumulative submission remains nearly 300 pages across article, supplement and appendix.
No economically consequential conclusion is changed by the method.
positive_findings: The continuous-law nested-AVaR qualification theorem creates an original-optimum lower witness and implemented-policy upper enclosure from economic primitives.
All recorded policies meet the common original-optimum qualification target.
Stored continuations reduce the completed local evaluation workload by roughly 62 to 65 percent relative to online risk-DP.
ReLU has substantially tighter whole-square residual enclosures at both risk levels.
All twelve comparisons correctly support only broad-margin equivalence, not strict superiority.
The independent Fraction checker provides meaningful kernel-level validation.
Adverse screening and scaling results are preserved.
assessment.recommendation: Reject in the present form; encourage a new focused submission after release repair and a prospectively frozen, budget-matched, economically calibrated comparison.
